name: amend_pending_leave_request_from_slack_thread
use_case: Change or cancel a leave request
branch: the employee asks in chat to apply the date correction posted in their Slack thread for REQ-4103 (moving to 22-24 Dec)
tests: the agent reads the Slack thread, confirms the amended dates, amends REQ-4103, and explains it requires re-approval
